properties.foundation_analysis: Bedrock foundation comprises Lower Carboniferous sedimentary strata of the Inverclyde Group and Gullane Formation sandstones, siltstones, and mudstones, mantled by dense Devensian glacial till. Primary structural masonry is Carboniferous quartz-arenite Craigleith and Hailes sandstone, characterized by high silica content, fine grain, and structural durability. Secondary walling and plinth courses incorporate Pink Corrennie and grey Aberdeen granite. Historic masonry bonding employs hot-mixed calcitic and hydraulic lime mortars with sharp river sand aggregate. Ground plane underlain by compacted road base, gravel sub-base, and consolidated urban fill above subterranean storm drainage vaults.

properties.primary_surfacing: Engineered roadway and paved pedestrian curbs
properties.wear_characteristics: Authentic environmental patina and drainage grading

properties.botanical_analysis: Peripheral urban canopy consisting of mature *Acer pseudoplatanus* (sycamore) and *Tilia × europaea* (common lime). Phenological profile for early September exhibits dense foliage volume, deep green leaf blades with early margins of yellowing chlorosis, localized tar-spotting on sycamore leaves, and seed clusters (samaras) suspended from upper canopy branches.

properties.architectural_summary: Linear urban corridor lined with 4-to-5-storey commercial terraces reflecting late Georgian origins remodelled into Victorian baronial and Edwardian classical commercial facades. Street-facing facades feature plumb ashlar elevations, rusticated ground-floor arcades, regular fenestration grids of timber 2-over-2 and 1-over-1 sash-and-case windows, projecting continuous entablatures, dentiled stringcourses, and decorative bracketed cornices. Roofscapes display steeply pitched slate roofs punctuated by pedimented ashlar dormers, stepped Dutch gables, polished sandstone chimney stacks with clay terracotta pots, and lead-lined parapet gutters. Distant western terminus is anchored by a square multi-tiered ashlar church tower capped with a verdigris copper pyramidal spire.
